title: Protocol v2.2 amendment: retire the unrecoverable DAY-15 legacy-cache preflight dependency; clean 42-session forward gate fwd-gate2
effective_from: the commit that contains this amendment and its adoption record; not earlier
authorization: explicit protocol-owner instruction 'DAY-26D — RESOLVE BLOCKERS, COMMIT, START A CLEAN FORWARD GATE' (2026-10-10)
append_only: protocol 2.1 files, its adoption record and the DAY-26C incident record are not modified; this amendment builds on them

disclosures.legacy_cache_unrecoverable: the 305 frozen DAY-15 legacy files under data/cache (artifacts/day15/integrity-baseline.json) were searched for on 2026-10-10 in git history (all refs), the research-data vault (release protocol-v2-historical-v1: stage_r, stage_h, evidence, manifest only; DAY-26 report: data/cache intentionally not vaulted) and local disks (Desktop, Downloads, Documents, depth 6); the only candidate, trade/smc-scanner/data/cache, matched 0/305 SHA-256. They are unrecoverable. No replacement was downloaded or regenerated.
disclosures.fwd_diag: FWD-DIAG-INVALID (protocol-breach) (DAY-26C) — unchanged and final; never relabelled
disclosures.quarantine: the 54 DAY-26C incident files stay in the quarantine directory outside every active data path; their SHA-256 inventory (artifacts/day26c) is enforced by backtest/v2/forward.check_quarantine

decisions.title: Stage F preflight without the legacy cache
decisions.rule: the Stage F capture preflight (acquisition/v2/stage_f.preflight) no longer requires DAY-15 data/cache; every other DAY-15 frozen directory (artifacts/day04 .. artifacts/day14) is still enforced: identical file set and each file equal to its baseline SHA-256 up to line endings only (raw, LF- or CRLF-normalised; DAY-25B precedent — the baseline itself mixes LF and CRLF files)
retained: forward access (status, time, adoption chain, config SHA, calendar, quarantine)
frozen protocol identity (DAY-16 + v2.0.1-v2.0.3 at their commits)

decisions.title: new clean gate fwd-gate2
decisions.rule: first XNYS session strictly after the DAY-26D commit day; 42 consecutive XNYS sessions; §13 gate (A/B/C) applied unchanged once after the final session

decisions.title: sample separation
decisions.rule: 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-09 (exposed in DAY-26C) and every earlier session are never part of the fwd-gate2 sample; they are formation history only, read mechanically by the frozen rules. The invalid fwd-diag is never part of fwd-gate2 metrics or benchmarks. Warm-up/lookback data come only from the single fresh Stage F acquisition below, never from quarantined files.

decisions.title: fresh immutable snapshot
decisions.rule: one Stage F acquisition for fwd-gate2 (stage_f_fwd-gate2_<UTC>), 2025-01-02 -> 2026-12-09, Alpaca SIP raw + all bars and corporate actions, write-once and read-only, own manifest with per-file SHA-256; offline validation must give READY_FOR_FORWARD_EVALUATION; loader and validator refuse a mutable (writable) snapshot. Acquisition parameters as in the v2.1 adoption record (asof = last session; CA Q1 process_date [2025-01-01, 2026-12-09]; event_date boundary [2025-01-02, 2026-12-09]; no assets endpoint).

decisions.title: invariants
unchanged: §7 no-lookahead tests (index, truncation, future mutation/deletion, fill source, timing)
E_0 = 100,000, start flat, liquidate at last close

calendar.earliest_final_evaluation: after a successful Stage F capture and READY_FOR_FORWARD_EVALUATION validation, not before 2026-12-09T16:15:00-05:00

acquisition_schedule.action: commit; the gate's sessions begin on 2026-10-12; nothing is acquired, computed or inspected during the blind period

evidence_disclaimer: a 42-session forward gate is weak long-term evidence and does not by itself authorise real-money trading

implementation.acquisition/v2/contract.py: fwd-gate2 window, expected Stage F sessions (486), EXPOSED_SESSIONS, PROTOCOL_VERSION_22
implementation.backtest/v2/forward.py: effective segment status (2.1 overlaid by 2.2; only PENDING accessible), check_adoption_22, check_config_sha, check_segment_calendar, check_snapshot_immutable
implementation.acquisition/v2/stage_f.py: preflight() (D1), frozen_baseline_check, eol_equivalent_sha; validate refuses a mutable snapshot
implementation.backtest/v2/run.py: SEGMENTS fwd-gate2; protocol version per segment
